data.narrative:
Manna Aero is a Series B drone and autonomous delivery company that has raised $110M to date. The broader Drones & Autonomous sector comprises 8 private peers—including Elroy Air, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and Archer Aviation—and no public comparables.

Valuation triangulation relies on a single applicable method: stage-progression analysis. Using total capital raised ($110M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to subsequent-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $209M. A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-filter comparables within the Drones & Autonomous space; while five same-sector peers exist, none meet the threshold of three or more datapoints when filtered by stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $178M to $240M, centered on $209M. This range reflects the inherent uncertainty in relying on a single method and the nascency of the sector's public valuation benchmarks. Key uncertainties include the scalability of Manna's regulatory pathway and unit economics relative to the peer set, neither of which the available data illuminates. Investors should treat this $209M median as indicative pending stronger comparable pricing data or near-term financing events within the cohort.
